en.title: Daily Accessibility Digest: GAAD Week Highlights Overlooked Groups and Global Inclusion Efforts
en.summary: GAAD Week highlights that the 1.3 billion disability figure undercounts older users, temporary impairments and situational limits; inclusion ensures equal access for people with disabilities; Central Asia is underrepresented at the Zero Project Conference, prompting a planned June 5 webinar; UN Women China is praised for prioritizing the rights and wellbeing of women with disabilities, showing that inclusion requires intentional action.

highlights.title: GAAD Week Highlights Overlooked Accessibility Groups
Inclusion ensures equal access for people with disabilities
Central Asia Underrepresented at Zero Project Conference, Webinar Planned
UN Women China praised for prioritizing women with disabilities' rights

zh-TW.title: 每日無障礙 digest：GAAD週凸顯被忽視群體與全球包容行動
zh-TW.summary: GAAD週指出13億殘疾人數字被低估，常忽略老年用戶、臨時障礙和情境限制；包容確保殘疾人平等獲取機會；中亞在零項目會議代表性不足，將舉辦6月5日網路研討會提升參與；聯合國婦女中國分獲讚賞，優先考慮殘疾婦女權利與福祉，顯示包容需要有意識的行動。

highlights.title: GAAD周突显被忽视的可访问性群体
包容确保残疾人平等获取机会
中亚在零项目会议中代表性不足，计划举办网络研讨会
感谢联合国妇女中国优先考虑残疾妇女的权利
